out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the warewashing station being used to wash food debris. Observed oil in sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Washing food/oil down the hand sink can lead to plumbing issues. CDI PIC agreed to use hand sink properly .

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the sink with a concentration of 100ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. CDI quat tablets added to 200ppm

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed that clean to-go boxes were stored in a manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean single-service and single-use articles in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor, unless kept in closed packages on pallets, racks, or skids. CDI stored inverted

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion: observed the lemon juicer paint chipping and is no longer resistant to corrosion.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. Replace peeler

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: The operator is not testing the chemical sanitizing solution to ensure proper concentration of the solution. Test kit not being used to check sanitizer and test stripes are discolored and compromised.
violations.corrective_action: The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device. CDI new test kit ordered

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED PIC WASHING HER HANDS IN THE FOOD PREPARATION SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CDI, EHS DISCUSSED PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES AT HANDWASHING SINKS ONLY.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: OBSERVED SALMON TO BE OFFERED FOR SALE UNDERCOOKED AND PIC COULD NOT PROVIDE A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. CDI PIC INFORMED TO FULLY COOK SALMON TO 145F UNTIL LETTER CAN BE PROVIDED TO EHS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED STANDING REFRIGERATOR (5) AT 47F WITH HALF AND HALF STORED INSIDE AT 51F, OBSERVED PREP TOP COOLER (6) TO BE 53F-59F WITH YOGURT AT 53F, COOKED POTATOES AT 51F, COOKED LENTILS AT 49F, AND DILL YOGURT AT 55F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI HALF AND HALF DISCARDED, AND TCS FOODS IN HOLDING UNIT DISCARDED AFTER 2HRS FROM TIME OF OBSERVATION. PIC EDUCATED ON PROPER COLD HOLDING FOR TCS FOODS AND DISCUSSED TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED FROZEN CHICKEN PLACED ON COUNTER IN AMBIENT CONDITIONS. PIC STATED CHICKEN WAS ON COUNTER FOR ~1HR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI CHICKEN PLACED IN WALK-IN COOLER AT TIME OF INSPECTION. PIC EDUCATED ON THAWING TCS FOODS.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no working temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: Flat-Top 2Dr Refrigerator. OBSERVED TWO THERMOMETERS IN THIS UNIT, AND NEITHER WERE WORKING PROPERLY.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. THERMOMETERS MUST BE PROPERLY FUNCTIONING. PLEASE REPLACE THERMOMETERS.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: MULTIPLE SPICES AND SAFFRON OIL
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI, ITEMS WERE LABELED AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: TWO DOOR PREP TOP. OBSERVED THIS UNIT TO MEASURE 53F ON TOP AND 59F ON BOTTOM.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. UNIT MUST BE REPAIRED PRIOR TO BEING USED TO HOLD TCS FOODS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the WALLS AND CEILING in the KITCHEN AND STORAGE AREA is in need of cleaning. OBSERVED BUILD-UP OF THICK BLACK DUST ON CEILING AND GRIME ON WALLS.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE BEGIN CLEANING THE FACILITY AT A HIGHER FREQUENCY, AND REMOVE THE DUST AND GRIME IN ORDER TO MAINTAIN CLEANLINESS AND AVOID CONTAMINATION.
